description: SGD with every default (lr 1e-3, no momentum, no weight decay). Shape [4, 8], 3 steps with a constant lr.
reference: torch.optim.SGD([p], lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, dampening=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, nesterov=False, foreach=False)
notes: Step s gives the gradient grad_s to the param; param_s and the state after it (training.md §5.2's names) are PyTorch's own f32 results (testing-strategy.md §2, "Optimizer tolerance").
